==Walkthrough==
===Animal workers===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Arhein]] on the [[Catherby]] docks. {{Chat option|2 What's with the duck?|1 Yes.}}
*Talk to [[Councillor Catherine]] in the council office in north-east Catherby.
*Fill in [[form cr-4p]] with any information, and '''remember what you chose.'''
**If you need charcoal, search the nearby cabinet.
*Talk to [[Councillor Catherine]] again.
}}

===Fish mayor===
{{Needed|50 coins.}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to Arhein. {{Chat option|2 I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.}}
*Talk to [[Harry]] at the fishing shop in east Catherby. {{Chat option|2 I'm here about the mayor.|1 Yes.}} He will sell you the [[mayoral fishbowl]] and [[tiny net]] for 50 coins.
*Fish in the aquarium next to Harry to catch a mayorfish.
*Talk to Arhein again to receive his mayoral chain. {{Chat option|2 About the mayor...}}
*Talk to Councillor Catherine again and match the answers you gave earlier.
*Use [[form 7r4-5h]] on the [[Mayor of catherby]] to sign it. Return the form to Catherine.
*Talk to Arhein again to receive the [[current duck]]. {{Chat option|2 The by-law has been changed!}}
}}

===Current duck===
{{Needed|Current duck.}}
{{Checklist|
*Board your boat to the south and sail east to find a small ripple in the water by the [[Obelisk of Water]].
**When near the ripple, click on the current duck on your inventory to set it in the water.
**Follow the duck until you get to the shore (near where [[Holgart]] is) and collect the duck.
*Talk to Arhein again. {{Chat option|2 I've charted the currents!}}
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
